Private Credit

# Jed Johnson Joins 9fin Webinar: The Evolution of Fund Finance


As the fund finance landscape evolves, lenders are getting creative about leveraging the technology to solve new problems.[Jed Johnson](https://www.orix.com/people/jed-johnson/) , Head of[GP Solutions](https://www.orix.com/private-credit/gp-solutions/) , recently joined the *9fin* webinar “The Evolution of Fund Finance” for a nuanced discussion on this changing landscape, and how NAV lending, GP financing and other fund finance tools are moving beyond traditional liquidity management to help managers navigate a tougher fundraising environment, maintain investment pace and access more flexible capital.


[Watch the Full Webinar](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=RltP29jcIIY)
